t: Time 6491X green/yellow conduit cable serves as a versatile earthing and bonding solution for light fittings, appliances, switchgear and control gear. This 25m drum features a single-core 1.5mm² stripped bare copper wire rated 450/750V. Designed for semi-flush, exposed and embedded conduit installations, the PVC sheath operates reliably between -15°C and 70°C. The slim 3mm external diameter with seven strands per core ensures straightforward installation and efficient current handling across residential, commercial and industrial electrical networks.
